episodes.title: Inside the Zizians, the Alleged Death Cult Linked to String of Killings and Suicides | Andy Ngo
episodes.description: There have been eight deaths—six killings and at least two suicides—linked to a radical group known as the Zizians. Investigative journalist Andy Ngo, who has been at the forefront of studying far-left violence, reveals how an extreme version of Silicon Valley rationalist philosophy and effective altruism gave rise to a death cult. His latest book is titled “The Zizians: Inside a Trans Death Cult.” Ngo believes there's a “clustering” effect at the most extreme fringes of transgender ideology, where psychiatric vulnerabilities, easy access to cross-sex hormones, and a persistent activist narrative of a “trans genocide” have combined to create a deadly feedback loop. In this episode, Ngo unpacks a disturbing landscape. How can online networks recruit and radicalize vulnerable youths? How did the Zizians form, and what have they done across the United States? And why have there been no trials? Views expressed in this video are opinions of the host and the guest, and do not necessarily reflect the views of The Epoch Times.
